tutorial.title: The Wayfarer's Oath
tutorial.subtitle: Interactive Prologue · Oakhaven Gatehouse
tutorial.summary: Learn d20 skill checks, flippable Relic Riddles, tactical combat intents, and Veil Dread before venturing into Valenmoor.

chapters.title: The Blight of Silverwood
chapters.subtitle: Chapter I · The Whispering Canopy
chapters.summary: Blackened thorns choke the ancient silver birches west of Oakhaven. Uncover who poisoned the Elder Heart-Tree before the forest turns against the bastion.

chapters.title: The Drowned Astrolabe
chapters.subtitle: Chapter II · The Sunken Star-Vaults
chapters.summary: Beneath mirror-still Lake Vesper, an ancient celestial observatory spins backward, pulling constellations and memories down into the abyss.

chapters.title: The Ember Covenant
chapters.subtitle: Chapter III · Ashenspire Forge
chapters.summary: Zealots inside the suspended obsidian foundry are bleeding Valenmoor's molten ley-veins to shatter the bindings of an elder cinder-drake.

chapters.title: The Shattered Spire
chapters.subtitle: Chapter IV · The Crown of Glass
chapters.summary: Ascend the fractured alabaster citadel hovering at the edge of unmaking. Every oath, relic, and scar converges before the Sovereign Loom.
